verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say Financial Connections gives access to an account's transaction history. A webhook fires when a transaction refresh completes, which supports a refresh-then-fetch pattern, and a community user plans to switch to Stripe's transactions API. The story's specifics are thin: history depth appears only in a community comment (daily pulls, up to 180 days), not in documentation. Missing for 10: documented pagination of transaction lists, a documented incremental or delta sync pattern for fetching only changed transactions, first-party documentation of history depth, and hands-on corroboration of the transactions API.
